programmes.d: A 1957 Ford Fairlane 500 that hasn't seen the road since 1957 gets revived.
The team faces obstacles while trying to get the Fairlane's engine running.
Dave and Kevin head to Colorado in hopes of winning an award for the shop.
David and Mike attempt to fill the Mazdarati void with their new Econorado.
David and Steve attempt to make their Super Sammy roadworthy.
David and Mike set out for Texas to enter their first burnout competition.
Mike and David try to get a neglected '64 Ford Galaxie up and running.
Two cars and two trucks vie for the title of best car for a high schooler.
The guys return to a parking lot to swap out the engine in a '74 Jag XJ12.
Mike and David trade their way through the 25th Hot Rod Power Tour.
Mike and David take their time reviving a junkyard rescue '71 Pontiac T-37.
Mike and Tony take on a big adventure in a little truck, a '70s Chevy LUV.
The show goes back to its roots, but with a bigger map and a newer Dart.
Dodge project cars race at the Roadkill Nights event in Pontiac, Michigan.
Mike, Tony and the '55 Chevy Bel Air compete in a brutal five-day test.
The guys want to revive the long-neglected '71 240Z and drive it to SEMA.
Mike and Tony divert from a road trip to accept a drag racing challenge.
The guys each pick an automotive nightmare and make the other guy drive it.
The T-Bizzle takes a road trip across the frozen tundra of the northern US.
Freiburger and Finnegan take a look at Roadkill's Top Project Cars.
The guys are on a quest to find the perfect 440 for a '66 Dodge truck.
The guys scrounge their parts piles and come up with impressive results.
